notes: A check before this device passes keys on (docs/e2ee-plan.md, contract/crypto/check.json): device, a device of this person in todo.devices, or user, a person in todo.people; commitment, SHA-256 of share-e2ee-v1/check and the asking device's nonce. Only a device that holds its person's key may ask, and only one that is listed there: 404 not_found otherwise. A new check replaces this device's earlier one for the same device or person. Then the waiting side answers (keys_check_answer.json), this device reveals its nonce (keys_check_reveal.json), and both show the code; after the person compares them, this device seals the keys with POST /api/keys/grants. DELETE /api/keys/checks/{id}, from either side, closes a check (204; 404 not_found). A check is good for 15 minutes.
